title: Mass Assignment Vulnerability in partners.uber.com

vulnerability.owasp_category: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

preconditions: An API/ORM binds request body fields directly to an internal object without an explicit allow-list of bindable fields

process.action: Capture a legitimate object-update request (e.g. profile update) and inspect the full internal object schema (via API docs, GraphQL introspection, or app responses)
process.expected_observation: Full field list of the underlying object, including fields not shown in the normal form (role, isAdmin, balance)

process.action: Add the extra, normally-hidden fields to the update request body
process.expected_observation: Response or subsequent fetch shows the extra field was actually updated

process.action: Target privilege-relevant fields specifically (role, isAdmin, verified, price, ownerId)
process.expected_observation: Privileged field successfully modified via the unprivileged update endpoint

impact: Privilege escalation by self-assigning an administrative role
Business logic bypass (e.g. setting a price or discount field directly)
remediation: Use explicit allow-lists (DTOs) defining exactly which fields a given endpoint may bind from user input
Never bind directly from request body to persistence-layer models
Apply field-level authorization checks for sensitive attributes
